title: The First Reopening
summary: Aten Ra now expresses this story arc through Sun-Scale Verdict Descent: one selected god or goddess enters The Sun-Scale Gate, survives stable gate under ma’at strain, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

A dead Mythos Gate begins breathing beneath broken threshold stone in the Solar Dominion of Khepra. Its first pulses do not open a road — they leak absence. Names vanish from tablets. Aten-Ra anchors noon judgment as Mesha Gate-Scribe reads the damage. The Hollow does not kill; it empties identity. Aten Ra proves the Gate is watching battle line, courage, and law rather than simply opening a path.
nextHook: The Gate's reopening sends tremors across all Realms. Asgardian oath-stones begin resonating with the solar judgment frequency.

title: Storm-Oath Covenant
summary: Asgardian now expresses this story arc through Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet: one selected god or goddess enters The Thunder-Oath Gate, survives ruin gate with active oath memory, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds answer the reopened Mythos Gate with thunder. Valhalla does not treat courage as mood — courage is a vow, and a vow has weight. The Gate tries to harvest that weight, turning every spoken oath into measurable pressure. The Asgardian answer is covenant: oath is responsibility, not fuel. When sworn courage is treated as a resource, the bridge replays old broken promises as terrain pressure.
nextHook: Olympian trial law and Asgardian covenant law now disagree over who owns victory after a Gate records it.

title: Laurel Senate Trials
summary: Olympian now expresses this story arc through Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial: one selected god or goddess enters The Laurel-Sky Gate, survives stable gate with oracle vapor leakage, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Olympian Realm turns the reopened Mythos Gate into public trial law. Olympus believes excellence proves divinity — but the Hollow watches from inside the trial records, testing whether glory can survive becoming law. The Marble Sky forces glory to become defense instead of vanity, while a Forgotten banner from a pre-Collapse war that both Olympian and Asgardian Realms deny starting pushes pride and oath toward reenacting an old catastrophe.
nextHook: Future Realm diplomacy can reference this campaign without enabling unrestricted mixed-faction Titans.
The trial records attract Kami attention — shrine law sees reflection as judgment, and the Gate's trial echoes are creating hostile mirror copies.

title: Kami Mirror Tempest
summary: Kami now expresses this story arc through Torii-Moon Mirror Road: one selected god or goddess enters The Torii-Moon Gate, survives distortion gate with ritual rerouting, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Shrine-Path Archipelago tests whether the Creator can cleanse Mythos Gate reflections without breaking shrine law or spirit contracts. The Kami Realm has always allowed passage but never possession. Reflections begin moving before their sources, shrine contracts fracture under Gate distortion, and the Creator must restore balance through precision, not force. Storm mirrors and foxfire gates turn every reflection into a potential hostile tactical lane.

The Gate's reflection distortion reaches into the Root-Crowned Green Below — Tuatha terrain begins remembering wounds it never received.

title: Roots Below the Gate
summary: Tuatha now expresses this story arc through Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth: one selected god or goddess enters The Silver-Root Gate, survives sealed gate with fae time bleed, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Tuatha Realm reveals that Mythos Gates wound living terrain, not just architecture. Roots have grown around impossible pressure beneath a damaged Gate — they did not invade the ruins, they held them together. Every branch, stone, and moonlit pool stores part of what the Collapse tried to erase. The campaign asks: when a wounded Realm adapts to catastrophe, does healing mean undoing the scar or learning what the scar now protects?

The living terrain's memory attracts Empyrean attention — the White Citadel sees the Tuatha's adaptive healing as evidence that order must be imposed before nature becomes unpredictable.

title: Empyrean Choir Vault
summary: Empyrean now expresses this story arc through Choir-Vault Discord Ascent: one selected god or goddess enters The Choir-Vault Gate, survives wound gate leaking memory-burning radiance, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Empyrean Realm ascends a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. The White Citadel believes existence can only survive through enforced hierarchy. Luminous choir platforms orbit the broken engine where harmonic gates rewrite battlefield elevation. At the summit, the choir engine sings a law that would erase every being that does not harmonize — mercy through annihilation, or tyranny through order.

title: Cinders of Dominion
summary: Infernal Dominion now expresses this story arc through Black-Iron Debt Descent: one selected god or goddess enters The Black-Iron Gate, survives distortion gate bound by contract clauses, and turns route rooms, hazards, Hollow run-ins, elite pressure, treasure/lore detours, and the boss chamber into playable canon.

The Black Iron Court treats Mythos Gate wounds as opportunity. The Infernal Dominion argues that control is the only mercy left after the Ascension Collapse proved trust insufficient. The Creator must navigate a campaign where every tactical victory creates a record, every record creates leverage, and every leverage point can become a chain. Ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence.

All seven Realms now hold pieces of the Reopening's truth. The question shifts from 'who controls the Gates' to 'who or what is calling them back to life.'
